name: Fiat S76, Fiat 300 HP Record, The Beast of Turin
description: The Fiat S76, later also known as Fiat 300 HP Record and nicknamed "The Beast of Turin", was a car built in 1910 by the Italian company Fiat specifically to beat the land speed record held in those years by the Blitzen Benz. Its 28,353 cc displacement engine delivered 290 hp. Only two examples were built.
author: Assetto Corsa Bootlegs
